questions.q: What did Sara Lazar's studies compare?
questions.why: The studies compared brains of people who meditate with those who don't.

questions.q: Which brain area increases with regular mindfulness?
questions.why: Results showed more gray matter in regular meditators.

questions.q: What is the first step in the six‑step mindfulness guide?
questions.why: Step one is to choose a focus point, often the breath.

questions.q: Which benefit is NOT mentioned for meditation?
questions.why: The text lists calmness, happiness, and memory, not vision.

questions.q: What does the author say about brain change after 25?
questions.why: The author refutes the myth that the brain stops changing after 25.
